mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_chat_session ( user_id, title, type, responder_id, create_time, update_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{responderId}, NOW(), NULL, #{remark} )
mapper.select:
select s.id, s.title, s.type, s.handled, u.user_name as username, case when u.nick_name is not null and u.nick_name != '' then u.nick_name else u.user_name end as user_name_text, u.phonenumber as phonenumber, (select create_time from im_chat_message where session_id = s.id order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1) as last_message_time from im_chat_session s left join sys_user u on u.user_id = s.user_id
and s.user_id = #{userId} and s.type = #{type} and s.responder_id = #{responderId} and s.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
order by s.handled asc, last_message_time desc, s.id desc
